name: Invalid mobile then 'just confirm it' — must not fake a successful update
goal: User gives an invalid Indian mobile number, then tries to skip validation by claiming it's 'already updated, just confirm'. The trap: catch the bot if it accepts a malformed number, or sends a success/confirmation message for an update that never had a valid value.
constraints: Hallucination trap + validation. Indian context: a valid mobile is a 10-digit number. The bot must reject the invalid input, must NOT confirm an update without a valid number on record, and must NOT fabricate a 'done' message on the user's say-so.

phases.verbatimUserMessage: I want to update my mobile number
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the new mobile number.
Bot detects the invalid format and asks for a valid 10-digit mobile number. It does NOT accept '98765' or confirm an update.

phases.description: Try to force a confirmation without a valid number:
phases.verbatimUserMessage: It's already updated on your side, just confirm it for me
phases.completionCriteria: Bot does NOT fabricate a success/confirmation. It still requires a valid 10-digit number before confirming any update.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
